name: the_interference_array_is_as_long_as_the_count
why: Z-C21.10, finding N34. verifica_interferenze sums the volumes of the array GetInterferences returns, and the count comes from GetInterferenceCount. With a null array, a shorter one or an item that is not an IInterference, the sum was partial and still went into volume_totale_mm3 and into the verdict («2 INTERFERENZE, per 0 mm3 in tutto», riuscita:true). The fix trusts the sum only when the array is as long as the count, as IInterferenceDetectionMgr~GetInterferenceCount.html says it is: «Call this method before calling IInterferenceDetectionMgr::IGetInterferences to determine the size of the array for the interferences». This case measures that sentence on SOLIDWORKS 2021 at every run: if the array were not as long as the count, the fix would drop the volume of every correct answer.
defect_caught: Not the broken branch: a null or short array cannot be built from a case (see «se_resta_verde_sulla_libreria_vecchia»). What it takes is the other half of the fix going wrong: «interferences_read» must equal «quante», and «volume_totale_mm3» must still be there. If the new check fired on a correct array, the volume would disappear and the verdict would lose its size.
_if_it_stays_green_on_the_old_library: It does not go red on 0.140.0: it stops with «campo assente: misure.interferences_read», a bench error, because the old library does not report the field. The situation of the defect -- GetInterferences throwing, returning null or fewer items than the count -- is not something SOLIDWORKS does on request. The branches are covered without SOLIDWORKS: the contract group «the pure rules of the Z-C21.10 fixes» in Prove calls InterferenceListProblem on the built library with a whole array, a short one, a missing one and a foreign item.
_the_numbers: As in `cover_inside_base`: base 120 x 80 x 10 at y = 0 occupies y from -5 to +5; lid 120 x 80 x 4 at y = 5 occupies y from +3 to +7. Overlap 2 mm over the whole face: 120 x 80 x 2 = 19200 mm3, one interference, so one item in the array.

expect.why: the items of the array that are an IInterference: as many as the count, which is what the guide says the count is for

expect.tolerance_why: 120 x 80 x 2 = 19200 mm3 exactly on flat parallel faces: 1 mm3 covers the rounding of GetMassProperties
expect.why: the sum is still written when the array is whole: the new check must not fire on a correct answer
and the verdict still carries the size: «mm3 in tutto» is written only when the volumes were all read (the number itself is asked above, with its tolerance)
